description: Shell script for testing Git repository cloning with submodules under various configurations, including remote tracking, partial clones, and filtering options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares Git configuration options between repositories.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the provided command fails.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
